usage: Homepage category gallery. Generated editorial ingredient scenes, not photographs of specific DNAture products or certified formulations. Category names and overlay are rendered in HTML/CSS.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: premium editorial category photograph for the DNAture pet nutrition website. Create one landscape image, 1536 x 1024, with no text.
Art direction shared across a five-image series: overhead food still-life, tactile matte blue-gray slate surface, understated cool daylight from upper left, natural ingredient colors, restrained professional food styling, crisp realistic textures, no oversaturation. Full-bleed photograph, no panels, borders or collage. One cohesive scene. Main objects kept in the middle 70% so the photo crops gracefully to square, landscape and portrait. The center should be readable beneath a separately added dark CSS overlay and white category title; do not render either overlay or text into the photo. Fill the scene generously with the food, not excessive empty surface. Use simple cool-white ceramic dishes where appropriate. No labels, packaging, logos, typography, watermarks, people, pets, cutlery or decorative flowers. This is an editorial ingredient scene, not a replica of specific commercial packaging. Natural shadows only.
Category: DESHIDRATADOS. A curated assortment of natural dehydrated dog treats: several long amber beef tendon strips, porous dark-brown dried beef lung pieces, and small whole dried sardines. Arrange in three loose organic groups on the slate, a few pieces overlapping, macro detail of the dried surfaces. Abundant food, refined rustic ingredient photography without a wooden board. No raw meat, no biscuits, no artificial bone-shaped treats.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the attached DNAture Recetas completas category photograph.
Change only the vegetable ingredients: remove every piece of broccoli and carrot, both the vegetables beside the bowl and the broccoli/carrot flecks in the minced meal. Replace the ingredients beside the bowl with fresh spinach leaves, a couple of recognizable curly kale leaves, and fresh turmeric roots with a few cut ends showing their golden interior. Arrange the spinach and kale naturally at the left/back of the bowl where the broccoli was; place the small turmeric roots and a restrained pinch of golden turmeric powder at the lower left where the carrot was. In the meal, use fine dark-green spinach/kale flecks with subtle golden turmeric flecks instead of carrot cubes or broccoli florets. Keep the meat looking like the same natural minced raw beef-and-poultry mixture.
Preserve the white ceramic bowl exactly, its scale, position, fullness, angle, the cool blue-gray slate backdrop, lighting direction, natural shadows, realistic photography, camera framing, and overall composition. Keep the category-image concept and photographic style unchanged. Produce a landscape image, approximately 1536 x 1024. No text, logos, labels, packaging, new props, graphics, overlays or watermarks. No broccoli or carrot should remain.
